reply_text:
The ticket is #8841. I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random.

Tobias posted it in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 09:27). He said West yard Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds checked in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it for support on ticket #8841. Pree is a member of that channel, so she could see the message herself.

His message called it "Tobias's dealer account" and didn't name Marrow Fieldworks. I'm treating it as Marrow Fieldworks because he has owned that account since January. In the reply I suggested Pree check the ticket's current status with Tobias before her call.

There's one possible mix-up. An April CRM note mentions a different ticket, MFW-218, for a door problem at the west receiving entrance, but that one involves doors 4 and 6, not Door 2. I didn't bring it up with Pree.
